## Behavior

Vrrsb
```{r}
# vrrsb
beh_dir <- "/Users/isabella/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/UMN/Postdoc/Control/Behavior"

vrrsb <- read_beh(beh_dir = beh_dir, file = "vrrsb01.txt", 
                  cols = list(videorefscore = "videorefscore",
                              socialcomm = "socialcomm",
                              rsbtotal = "rsbtotal"))%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(id, age),
               names_to  = "item",
               values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(measure = "VRRSB") 


vrrsb <- read_beh(beh_dir = beh_dir, file = "vrrsb01.txt", 
                  cols = list(videorefscore = "videorefscore",
                              rsbtotal = "rsbtotal"))

vrrsb_avg <- vrrsb %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarize(vr_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
            videorefscore_mean = mean(videorefscore, na.rm = TRUE),
            rsbtotal_mean = mean(rsbtotal))
```

# Matrices

Plot matrices
```{r}

mat_dir <- "/Users/isabella/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/UMN/Postdoc/Control/matrices/matrices_csv"
mats <- dir(mat_dir, "*.csv")

p_dir <- "/Users/isabella/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/UMN/Postdoc/Control/matrices/plots"

for (m in mats){
  id <- sapply(strsplit(m, "_ses"), "[", 1)
   ses <- gsub("[^0-9.]", "", sapply(strsplit(m, "_"), "[", 2))
  mat <- read.csv(file.path(mat_dir, m))
  mat <- as.matrix(mat[1:100, 1:100])
  rownames(mat) <- colnames(mat) <- 1:100
  
  mat_melt <- melt(mat)
  
    nodes <- sort(unique(c(mat_melt$Var1, mat_melt$Var2)))
  n <- length(nodes)
  
  # total possible undirected edges (no self-loops)
  total_possible <- n * (n - 1) / 2
  
  pct_nonzero <- round((sum(mat_melt$value > 0) / total_possible)*100, 0)
  
  network_labels <- data.frame(
    parcel = unique(mat_melt$Var1),
    network = labels$network)
  
  mat_melt <- mat_melt %>%
    left_join(network_labels, by = c("Var1" = "parcel")) %>%
    left_join(network_labels, by = c("Var2" = "parcel"), suffix = c("_x", "_y"))
  


  
  net_colors = network_colors
  
  # Plot matrix with bottom and left network bars
  ggplot(mat_melt, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    ) +
    new_scale_fill() +
    # Bottom bar (was top)
    geom_tile(
      aes(x = Var1, y = 0, fill = network_x),
      height = 1.5  # controls thickness
    ) +
    # Left bar
    geom_tile(
      aes(x = 0, y = Var2, fill = network_y),
      width = 1.5  # controls thickness
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = net_colors, name = "Network") +
    coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
    ggtitle(sprintf("%s session %s (perc nonzero = %s)", id, ses, pct_nonzero))
  
  ggsave(file.path(p_dir, sprintf("%s_%s.jpeg", id, ses)))
}

```



# Read in transitions control
Dorsal attention
```{r}
tran_dir <- "/Users/isabella/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/UMN/Postdoc/Control/nctpy/transitions_results_DorsAttn"

all_trans_dorsa <- data.frame()
for (t in dir(tran_dir)){
  dat <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(tran_dir, t))
  dat <- cbind(data.frame(id = names(dat), 
                          ses = sapply(strsplit(t, "_"), "[", 2), node = 1:100), data.frame(dat[[1]]))
  all_trans_dorsa <- rbind(all_trans_dorsa, dat)
  rm(dat)
}

all_trans_dorsa <- merge(all_trans_dorsa, labels, by = "node", all.x = TRUE)
all_trans_dorsa$id <- gsub("sub-", "", all_trans_dorsa$id)
all_trans_dorsa$id <- as.integer(all_trans_dorsa$id)
all_trans_dorsa$session <- as.numeric(stringr::str_extract_all(all_trans_dorsa$ses , "\\d+"))
all_trans_dorsa <- merge(all_trans_dorsa, demo, by = c("id", "session"), all.x = TRUE)
all_trans_dorsa$energy <- as.numeric(all_trans_dorsa$energy)

all_trans_dorsa$age <- round(all_trans_dorsa$Scan_Age, 0)

all_trans_dorsa <- all_trans_dorsa %>%
  arrange(id, session, node)
all_trans_dorsa$energy_log <- log1p(all_trans_dorsa$energy)

ggplot(aes(x = network, y = energy_log), data = all_trans_dorsa) +
  geom_jitter(aes( color = network), alpha = 0.4) +
     geom_violin() +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", 
               width = 0.5, color = "black", 
               fatten = 2, size = 0.6) +
  ylab("Energy (log)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Total Energy Required to Activate dorsa State")
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "dorsa_energy_vio.jpeg"))

all_trans_dorsa_split <- all_trans_dorsa %>%
  group_by(id, session, network) %>%
  summarize(total_energy = sum(energy))
all_trans_dorsa_split <- merge(all_trans_dorsa_split, demo, by = c("id", "session"), all.x = TRUE)


all_trans_dorsa <- all_trans_dorsa %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  summarize(total_energy = mean(total_energy))

all_trans_dorsa <- merge(all_trans_dorsa, qc, by = c("id", "session"), all.x = TRUE)
all_trans_dorsa$q[is.na(all_trans_dorsa$q)] <- 0



all_trans_dorsa <- merge(all_trans_dorsa, demo, by = c("id", "session"), all.x = TRUE)


```

```{r}
for (t in dir(tran_dir)){
```

```{r}
# nodel level age cors
age_cor_by_net <- all_trans_som %>%
  group_by(node) %>%
  summarize(
    age_cor = cor(Scan_Age, energy, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    n = sum(complete.cases(Scan_Age, energy)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
hist(age_cor_by_net$age_cor)
km <- kmeans(age_cor_by_net$age_cor, centers = 2)
age_cor_by_net <- data.frame(
  value   = age_cor_by_net,
  cluster = factor(km$cluster)
)
```

# Comparing dev slopes
```{r}

t_dir <- "/Users/isabella/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/UMN/Postdoc/Control/tables/"

library(ggplot2)

# comparing within-person slopes
library(dplyr)

df_long <- all_trans %>%   # id, session, network, total_energy, Scan_Age
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    Scan_Age_pm = mean(Scan_Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    age_w = Scan_Age - Scan_Age_pm,      # within-person age change
    age_b = Scan_Age_pm                  # between-person age (optional)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
library(lme4)

# modeling all change in energy for all brain state transitions

df_long$network <- relevel(factor(df_long$network), ref = "Ment")

m1 <- lmer(total_energy ~  site_shell + Scan_Age + q
           + network + Scan_Age*network
  + (1 | id),
  data = df_long
)
summary(m1)

library(ggeffects)
library(sjPlot)
pred <- ggpredict(
  m1,
  terms = c("Scan_Age [all]", "network")
)

tab_model(m1, title = "Age-Related Change in Energy by Brain State", CSS = list(css.table = '+font-family: Arial;'),
          file = file.path(t_dir, "age_model.html")) #file = d)
```

Slope comparison
```{r}

library(emmeans)

slopes <- emtrends(m1, ~ network, var = "Scan_Age") #age_w")
slopes

# which slopes differ from zero
summary(slopes, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), adjust = "BH")

pairs(slopes)

pairwise_slopes <- pairs(slopes, adjust = "BH")  # or "tukey", "bonferroni", etc.

pairwise_table <- as.data.frame(pairwise_slopes)

library(kableExtra)
pairwise_table %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    SE = round(SE, 3),
    # t = round(t.ratio, 2),
    p = signif(p.value, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(contrast, estimate, SE, df, p)%>%
  kbl(format = "html", caption = "Pairwise slope comparisons (BH-adjusted)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  save_kable(file.path(t_dir, "pairwise_slopes.html"))
```

Pairwise slope comparisons 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)


test <- cbind(data.frame(slopes) %>% select(c(net1 = network, Scan_Age.trend1= Scan_Age.trend)),
              data.frame(slopes) %>% select(c(net2 = network, Scan_Age.trend2 = Scan_Age.trend)))


pairs_df2 <- merge(pairs_df2, test %>% select(net1, Scan_Age.trend1), 
                   by = c("net1"), all.x = TRUE)
pairs_df2 <- merge(pairs_df2, test %>% select(net2, Scan_Age.trend2), 
                   by = c("net2"), all.x = TRUE)

pairs_df2 <- pairs_df2 %>% mutate(
    includes_zero = asymp.LCL <= 0 & asymp.UCL >= 0,
    sig = !includes_zero   # TRUE = CI does NOT include 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff = Scan_Age.trend1 - Scan_Age.trend2
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(diff)), net2) %>%   # largest difference at top
  mutate(
    contrast_label = factor(contrast_label, levels = contrast_label)
  )

names(network_colors) <- c("Vis", "Som", "DorsAttn", "SalVentAttn", "Limb", "Cont", "DMN")
names(other_colors) <- c( "Lang", "Soc Cog")

pairs_df2<- pairs_df2 %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.character),
    ~ ifelse(. == "Ment", "Soc Cog", .)
  ))


trade_slopes <- ggplot(pairs_df2, aes(y = contrast_label, alpha = as.factor(sig))) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = Scan_Age.trend1,
      xend = Scan_Age.trend2,
      yend = contrast_label,
      alpha = as.factor(sig)
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = Scan_Age.trend1, color = net1),
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = Scan_Age.trend2, color = net2),
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(network_colors, other_colors)) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.25), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    # alpha = "Significant",
    color = "Brain State",
    x = "Slope Reflecting Energy Change with Age",
    y = "Pairwise Comparison",
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 6),
        plot.title   = element_text(size = 10, hjust= 0.5)) +
  ggtitle("Pairwise Comparisons of Age-Related Slopes in \n Brain State Energy Requirements")

trade_slopes
```

## energy tradeoffs
```{r}
all_trans_lang2 <- rbind(all_trans_lang[, 1:7] %>% mutate(network = "Lang"),
                         all_trans_som[, 1:7] %>% mutate(network = "Som"),
                         all_trans_con[, 1:7] %>% mutate(network = "Cont"))


all_trans_lang2 <- all_trans_lang2 %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = network, 
              values_from = total_energy) %>%
  mutate(lang_minus_som = Lang - Som,
         lang_minus_con = Lang - Cont)
 all_trans_lang2$lang_above_som <- ifelse(all_trans_lang2$lang_minus_som > 0, 1, 0)
 
 all_trans_lang2 <- merge(all_trans_lang2, mullen, by = c("id", "session"), all.x = TRUE)


# the greater lang is relative to som, the higher rbs --the greater som is relative ot lang, better reciprocal social behav
lmer.rsb <- lmer(lang_minus_som  ~ el_ae + site_shell #~ lang_minus_som 
                 + (1 | id), REML= FALSE, data = all_trans_lang2)
summary(lmer.rsb)

lmer.rsb <- lmer(Lang ~ el_ae + lang_minus_som #lang_above_som:rsbtotal_mean 
                 + site_shell #~ lang_minus_som 
                 + (1 | id), REML= FALSE, data = all_trans_lang2) #lmerControl(autoscale = TRUE))
summary(lmer.rsb)

lmer.rsb <- lmer(lang_minus_con ~ el_ae + site_shell #~ lang_minus_som 
                 + (1 | id), REML= FALSE, data = all_trans_lang2)
summary(lmer.rsb)

```

# All control-behavior correlations

```{r}

any(duplicated(paste(all_beh$id, all_beh$age, all_beh$item)))

all_beh <- all_beh %>% 
  arrange(id, age)

all_trans <- rbind(all_trans_con[, 1:7] %>% mutate(network = "Cont"),
                   all_trans_dmn %>% mutate(network = "DMN"),
                   all_trans_vis %>% mutate(network = "VIS"),
                   all_trans_dorsa %>% mutate(network = "DorsalAttn"),
                   all_trans_lang[, 1:7] %>% mutate(network = "Lang"),
                   all_trans_ment[, 1:7] %>% mutate(network = "Soc Cog"),
                   all_trans_sal %>% mutate(network = "SalVent"),
                   all_trans_som %>% mutate(network = "Som")) %>%
  arrange(id, session)

all_trans <- merge(
  all_trans,
  all_beh %>% select(id, session = age, item, score, measure),
  by = c("id", "session")
)
all_trans <- all_trans[!is.na(all_trans$item), ]

length(unique(all_trans$id)) # 141

corr_by_item_network <- all_trans %>%
  group_by(measure, item, network) %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(total_energy, score, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    p = cor.test(total_energy, score)$p.value,
    n = sum(!is.na(total_energy) & !is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(network) %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


library(ggplot2)

ggplot(corr_by_item_network, aes(x = network, y = item, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(!is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05, "*", "")),
    size = 5
  ) +
  facet_grid(measure ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    high = "#4575B4", mid = "white", low = "#D73027",
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "r"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold")  #
  ) +
  xlab("Energy Required to Activate Brain State") +
  ylab("Behavior") +
  ggtitle("Correlations Between Brain State Energies and Behavior")
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Fig5_beh_en_corr.jpeg"), width = 10, height = 7)
```
